s:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are incorrect?
a. Vijayaditya II is credited with the construction of 108 temples.
b. Raja Raja Narendra constructed Rajarajeswara temple at Biccavole.
c. Chalukya Bhima constructed Bhimeswara Swamy temple at Draksharama.
x:
Statement (a): Correct. Vijayaditya II earned the title Narendramrugaraja and is traditionally credited with constructing 108 temples to commemorate his military victories. This achievement is frequently mentioned in Eastern Chalukya history. Statement (b): Incorrect. The Rajarajeswara Temple at Biccavole was not constructed by Raja Raja Narendra. Biccavole contains several temples belonging to the Eastern Chalukya period, but there is no historical evidence attributing the construction of the Rajarajeswara Temple specifically to Raja Raja Narendra. Statement (c): Correct. Chalukya Bhima I is traditionally credited with constructing the famous Bhimeswara Swamy Temple at Draksharama, one of the Pancharama Kshetras of Andhra Pradesh. Since only Statement (b) is incorrect, the correct answer is
Option (3).
n: Chalukya Bhima I – Bhimeswara Temple, Draksharama
Draksharama – One of the Pancharama Kshetras

s: The architectural structure of which of the following temples signifies the independent style of the Chalukya-Cholas, incorporating Pallava and early Chalukya influences?
x:
The Draksharama Bhimeswara Temple represents the mature architectural style developed under the Chalukya-Cholas. Its design combines features of Pallava architecture, such as elegant structural planning, with Early Chalukyan elements, resulting in a distinctive regional style. This fusion later influenced temple architecture across the Godavari region. The Brihadeeshwara Temple at Thanjavur is a masterpiece of Imperial Chola architecture and does not represent the independent Chalukya-Chola style. The Padmakshi Temple at Hanamkonda is associated primarily with the Kakatiyas and reflects Kakatiya architectural traditions rather than Chalukya-Chola architecture.
Therefore, Draksharama Temple is the correct answer.

s: Eastern Chalukya king who built 108 temples named Narendresvaralayas?
x:
Vijayaditya II of the Eastern Chalukya dynasty is credited with constructing 108 temples, popularly known as Narendresvaralayas. According to historical tradition, these temples were built to commemorate his victories in battle and his devotion to Lord Shiva. Temple construction flourished under the Eastern Chalukyas, contributing significantly to the architectural heritage of Andhra Pradesh.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (4).
